cards.name: Wilderness Expeditions
cards.description: CORE's Frogs and Salamanders groups take a six-day local summer expedition. The teen Amphibians group takes a 10- to 20-day summer expedition involving activities such as backpacking, canoeing, or rock climbing.
cards.review_notes: The expedition description is undated on a page advertising Fall 2026 enrollment; 2026 is a fallback context, not an explicitly dated expedition season. Confirm summer dates and whether participation requires ongoing CORE membership. Ages span the stated Frogs and Salamanders groups (10–12) and Amphibians group (13–18). No session rows can be dated. Weekly meeting venues and September–May tuition were not treated as expedition departure sites or summer prices.
